observation_window.purpose: Give Kevin breathing room to advance independent GREEN work while the Forge failure family is quarantined.
observation_window.success_condition: No new demandless Forge retry is credited; Kevin selects eligible work from evidence, executes it, verifies it, and then updates WIP from actual running state.

note: Selection state only. It does not grant authority or execute work. WIP counts only evidence-backed running work; planned/preferred work remains eligible. Blocked/cooling work never consumes WIP.
